title_zh: Taking telephone messages - 53 - English at Work helps you note it down
title_en: Taking telephone messages - 53 - English at Work helps you note it down
videoTitle: Taking telephone messages - 53 - English at Work helps you note it down
textbookTitle_zh: 忙的时候接电话：记下名字、号码和什么时候回
note_zh: 整集 4:57。BBC《English at Work》第 53 集，演员真人配音，字幕即官方台词。

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.en: Will someone answer that phone?
sentences.zh: 谁去接一下电话？

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: The office has become chaotic since Denise left, just when things are getting busy.
sentences.zh: Denise 一走，办公室就乱了，偏偏事情又忙起来。

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.en: Hello. Yes? It is. We're very busy, so call back later. Bye.
sentences.zh: 喂。对，是。我们很忙，你过会儿再打。再见。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: That was a bit rude, Tom.
sentences.zh: Tom，这有点无礼。

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.en: Well, we're too busy to be nice.
sentences.zh: 我们忙得没工夫客气。

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: Even when you are busy, it's important to be polite on the phone. It could be a potential customer.
sentences.zh: 再忙，电话上也要客气。说不定是潜在客户。

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: You could say: We're a bit busy at the moment. Could I take your name and number, and we'll call you back? When would be a convenient time to call you?
sentences.zh: 你可以这样说：我们这会儿有点忙。我能记下你的名字和号码，再打给你吗？什么时候打给你方便？
sentences.note: When would be a convenient time to call you? 约回拨时间，不要只说我们很忙。

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: If they want a particular person, say: Could I take a message, and I'll make sure he or she calls you back?
sentences.zh: 如果他们要找某个具体的人：我能记个口信，让他回你吗？

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.en: Anna, could you get that, please? I've got a mouthful of biscuit.
sentences.zh: Anna，你接一下好吗？我嘴里塞着饼干。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Hello? Tip Top Trading. Yes, that's right, but things are a bit busy at the moment. Could I take your name and number, and I'll call you back as soon as I can?
sentences.zh: 你好，Tip Top Trading。对，是这里，不过我们这会儿有点忙。我能记下你的名字和号码，尽快打回去吗？

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Has anyone got a pen?
sentences.zh: 谁有笔？

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.en: I think we've run out. Denise usually orders them. Here, use my souvenir pen.
sentences.zh: 好像用完了。通常是 Denise 订的。给，用我这支纪念笔。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: There's no paper to write it on.
sentences.zh: 没有纸可以写。

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.en: Write it on my hand.
sentences.zh: 写在我手上。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Hold still. 7-4-9-0-5-6-8. Thanks for your patience. When is a good time to call you back? Okay, three o'clock. I'll call you then. Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 别动。7490568。谢谢你等。什么时候回你方便？好，三点。我那时打给你。再见。
sentences.note: Thanks for your patience. 让对方等了之后用。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Hello, Tip Top Trading, Anna speaking. I see. He doesn't seem to be here at the moment. Can I take a message, and I'll get him to call you back?
sentences.zh: 你好，Tip Top Trading，我是 Anna。明白。他这会儿好像不在。我能记个口信，让他回你吗？

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Tom, I need your other hand. The message is: call Bob about the lemons, on 8-0-9-5-2-4. I'll pass that on.
sentences.zh: Tom，我得用你另一只手。口信是：打给 Bob，谈柠檬的事，号码 809524。我会转告。
sentences.note: I'll pass that on. 我来转达。

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.en: It's been crazy here since Denise left. We've even run out of teabags.
sentences.zh: Denise 走了以后这儿忙疯了。茶包都没了。

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.en: Has that invoice for Tutti Fruity been sent out yet?
sentences.zh: 给 Tutti Fruity 的那张发票发出去了吗？

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.en: I don't know. Denise usually sends out the paperwork.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。文件通常是 Denise 发的。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Ah, there you are, Tom. I need to give Paul that message I wrote on your hand.
sentences.zh: 你回来了，Tom。我得把写在你手上的口信告诉 Paul。

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.en: It's a bit tricky. I went to the toilet and then I washed my hands.
sentences.zh: 有点麻烦。我去了洗手间，然后洗了手。

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.en: Oh no, you've washed the messages off. We can't carry on like this.
sentences.zh: 完了，口信被你洗掉了。不能再这样下去。

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.en: However hectic things get, remain professional when you answer the phone. We're a bit busy. Could I take your name and number? When would be a convenient time? Could I take a message?
sentences.zh: 不管多乱，接电话要保持专业。我们有点忙；我记下名字和号码；什么时候方便；我记个口信。
